verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a robotics framework, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows developer building blocks: nodes, a launch system, actions for long-running tasks, and lifecycle nodes, all of which a developer would use to construct autonomous behavior. It also mentions an adjacent background daemon that only caches graph information for CLI queries. Nothing documents a first-party way for a user to set up automations that run unattended in the background.
